name.zh: 定量出米密封防潮儲米桶 10kg

summary.en: A 10kg sealed rice dispenser that releases a measured portion with each turn. A practical, hygienic choice for households and retail kitchenware ranges.
summary.zh: 10kg 密封儲米桶，每次旋轉即定量出米。衛生實用，適合家庭及廚具零售系列。

features.en: Rotary dial releases 150g of rice, about two bowls, per turn.
features.zh: 旋鈕設計，每次定量出米 150g，約兩碗飯。

features.en: Built-in moisture absorber keeps stored rice dry.
features.zh: 內置防潮棒，吸收桶內多餘濕氣，保持乾爽。

features.en: Drawer-style tray seals again as soon as it is pushed back.
features.zh: 抽屜式取米盒，推回即密封，防潮防塵。

features.en: Funnel chamber guides every grain out, leaving no old rice behind.
features.zh: 漏斗式出米倉斜坡導流，不留陳米。

features.en: Wide sealed lid for spill-free refilling.
features.zh: 大口徑密封上蓋，添米不易灑漏。

features.en: Transparent body with clear level markings.
features.zh: 透明箱體配清晰刻度，餘量一目了然。

tagline.en: Fast, gentle drying with a hint of fragrance.

summary.en: A 1600W brushless hair dryer with intelligent temperature control, high-density negative ions and optional fragrance modules. A refined personal care gift in four colours.
summary.zh: 1600W 無刷摩打風筒，配備智能溫控、高濃度負離子及可選香薰模組。四色可選，是講究的個人護理禮品。

features.en: 1600W power with a 110,000 RPM brushless motor for fast drying.
features.zh: 1600W 功率，配 110000 RPM 高速無刷摩打，快速乾髮。

features.en: NTC smart temperature control helps prevent heat damage.
features.zh: NTC 智能溫控，精準調節風溫，防止髮質過熱受損。

features.en: 200 million/cm³ negative ions reduce static and frizz.
features.zh: 2 億/cm³ 高濃度負離子，中和靜電，撫平毛躁。

features.en: Colour ring light shows hot, warm or cool air at a glance.
features.zh: 環形燈光以紅、橙、藍色顯示熱風、溫風及冷風。

features.en: Optional green tea, osmanthus, cocoa and cologne fragrance modules.
features.zh: 可另配綠茶、桂花、可可、古龍四款香薰模組。

features.en: Magnetic nozzle and operation below 59dB at 50cm.
features.zh: 磁吸式風嘴，運行噪音低於 59dB（距離 50cm）。

value.en: Green tea, osmanthus, cocoa, cologne (modules installed separately)
value.zh: 綠茶／桂花／可可／古龍（需另行安裝）

name.en: Auto-Clip Wet and Dry Floor Mop
name.zh: 家用自動夾布乾濕兩用拖把

tagline.en: Change the cloth. Never touch the dirt.
tagline.zh: 換布免沾手，清潔更從容。

summary.en: A press-to-release flat mop that holds cloths or disposable wipes securely for wet or dry cleaning. A practical line for home care retail.
summary.zh: 按壓式換布平板拖把，可牢固夾持清潔布或即棄抹紙，乾濕兩用。適合家居清潔零售系列。

features.en: Press-to-release mechanism changes cloths without touching dirt.
features.zh: 按壓即可裝卸拖布，全程免手觸污垢。

features.en: Ten pairs of clips hold cleaning cloths or wipes firmly.
features.zh: 10 對鱷魚夾，牢固夾持多種清潔布及抹紙。

features.en: Textured base stops the cloth shifting during use.
features.zh: 拖板底部設防滑花紋，防止拖布移位。

features.en: Supplied with four absorbent, dust-trapping cleaning cloths.
features.zh: 附 4 片清潔布，吸水鎖塵。

features.en: 360° swivel head reaches under furniture and into corners.
features.zh: 360° 靈活旋轉，輕鬆深入傢俬底部及牆角。

value.en: 10 pairs of clips with textured base
value.zh: 10 對鱷魚夾 + 花紋拖板輔助固定

name.zh: 智能保溫 USB 速熱暖墊 60 × 30 cm

summary.en: A low-voltage USB-C heating pad with three temperature levels and automatic shut-off. A thoughtful, portable wellness gift for office and home.
summary.zh: 5V 低壓 USB-C 暖墊，設三段溫度及自動斷電。輕巧便攜，是辦公室與居家皆宜的健康禮品。

features.en: 5V low-voltage USB-C input works with power banks and computers.
features.zh: 5V 安全低壓 USB-C 輸入，可連接行動電源或電腦。

features.en: Three temperature settings: 45°C, 50°C and 55°C.
features.zh: 三段溫度調節：45°C／50°C／55°C。

features.en: 60 × 30 cm size suits the abdomen, back, shoulders and limbs.
features.zh: 60 × 30 cm 尺寸，適用於腹部、腰部、肩頸及四肢。

features.en: Switches off automatically after two hours of use.
features.zh: 連續運作 2 小時後自動斷電。

name.en: Cordless Wet and Dry Floor Washer
name.zh: 無線充電乾濕兩用吸塵洗地機

tagline.en: Vacuum and wash, in a single pass.

summary.en: A cordless floor washer with 12000Pa suction, separate clean and dirty water tanks and self-cleaning with hot-air drying. Built for whole-home cleaning on one charge.
summary.zh: 無線洗地機，具 12000Pa 吸力、淨污分離雙水箱及自動清潔熱風烘乾。單次充電即可完成全屋清潔。

features.en: 12000Pa suction from a high-speed brushless motor, wet or dry.
features.zh: 高速無刷電機，濕拖與吸塵模式均達 12000Pa 吸力。

features.en: 4000mAh battery runs for about 40 minutes per charge.
features.zh: 4000mAh 鋰電池，單次充電可連續運作約 40 分鐘。

features.en: Self-cleaning with PTC hot-air drying, about 90% dry in two hours.
features.zh: 自動清潔配 PTC 熱風烘乾，約 2 小時滾刷達 90% 乾燥。

features.en: Separate 850ml clean and 600ml dirty water tanks.
features.zh: 850ml 淨水箱與 600ml 污水箱分離，避免交叉污染。

features.en: Display shows water and battery status.
features.zh: 機身屏幕提示補水、換水及電量狀態。

features.en: Optimised airflow keeps operation at 66.9 dB(A).
features.zh: 優化風道降噪，運作聲音為 66.9 dB(A)。

name.zh: 家用上臂式電子血壓計

summary.en: An automatic upper-arm monitor with two user memories, irregular heartbeat detection and a WHO colour indicator. A considered wellness gift for families and senior clients.
summary.zh: 自動上臂式血壓計，設雙用戶記憶、心律不正偵測及 WHO 彩色指示條。是送給家人及長者客戶的貼心健康禮品。

features.en: Automatic inflation measures systolic, diastolic pressure and pulse.
features.zh: 全自動加壓，同步測量收縮壓、舒張壓及脈搏。

features.en: Two users with 120 records each, plus 7-day morning and evening averages.
features.zh: 2 位用戶各儲存 120 筆記錄，並計算最近 7 日早晚平均值。

features.en: Irregular heartbeat, cuff fitting and movement detection.
features.zh: 具備心律不正、袖帶佩戴及過度動作偵測。

features.en: WHO colour-coded scale for quick interpretation.
features.zh: WHO 血壓等級彩色指示條，快速解讀血壓狀況。

features.en: Backlit LCD and automatic shut-off after 30 seconds idle.
features.zh: LCD 背光顯示，閒置 30 秒自動關機。

features.en: Powered by three AAA batteries or USB-C; storage pouch included.
features.zh: 可用 3 顆 AAA 電池或 USB-C 供電，附收納袋及記錄冊。

value.zh: 2 位用戶 × 每位 120 筆

tagline.en: Full-size comfort. Folds away to nothing.

summary.en: An 8-inch telescopic fan with oscillation, remote control and a timer that folds down compactly. Ideal for homes, offices and seasonal promotions.
summary.zh: 8 吋伸縮風扇，具自動擺頭、遙控及定時功能，摺疊後小巧易收納。適合家居、辦公室及季節推廣。

features.en: Three fan speeds, from a gentle breeze to strong airflow.
features.zh: 3 段風速調節，由柔風至強風。

features.en: Automatic 90° left-right oscillation for wider coverage.
features.zh: 左右 90° 自動擺頭，送風範圍更廣。

features.en: Infrared remote control with a range of up to 8 metres.
features.zh: 紅外線遙控，操作距離最遠 8 米。

features.en: Remote-set timer up to 4 hours.
features.zh: 遙控定時，最長可設 4 小時。

features.en: Folds to just 200 × 200 × 100 mm for storage.
features.zh: 摺疊收納尺寸僅 200 × 200 × 100 mm。

name.zh: PD 67W 快充旅行轉換插頭

summary.en: A universal travel adaptor with US, EU, UK and AU plugs and 67W PD fast charging. A dependable corporate gift for frequent travellers.
summary.zh: 萬用旅行轉插，支援美規、歐規、英規、澳規插頭，配 PD 67W 快充。是商務旅客的可靠企業禮品。

features.en: Flame-retardant PC housing rated 94V-0, with phosphor bronze contacts.
features.zh: PC 阻燃外殼符合 94V-0 標準，內部採用磷銅導電金屬。

features.en: US, EU, UK and AU plug types for international travel.
features.zh: 美規、歐規、英規、澳規插頭，適配多國地區。

features.en: AC socket rated 10A for high-power appliances.
features.zh: AC 插座額定電流 10A，滿足高功率電器需要。

features.en: 67W PD fast charging for phones, tablets and laptops.
features.zh: PD 67W 快充，為手機、平板及手提電腦充電。

features.en: Wide 100–250V input for use around the world.
features.zh: 100–250V 寬電壓輸入，各國通用。

name.zh: 無線負離子充電直髮梳

summary.en: A rechargeable ionic straightening brush with three heat settings and a 4000mAh battery, supplied with a travel pouch. A polished personal care gift for professionals on the move.
summary.zh: 充電式負離子直髮梳，設三段溫度及 4000mAh 電池，附便攜收納袋。適合經常出行的專業人士，是精緻的個人護理禮品。

features.en: 37 heated teeth straighten while 32 guide teeth prevent tangles.
features.zh: 37 顆恆溫發熱梳齒拉直秀髮，32 顆輔助梳齒防止打結。

features.en: Rounded teeth help avoid pulling and damage.
features.zh: 圓形梳齒，避免拉扯及磨損頭髮。

features.en: Negative ions reduce static and frizz for a smooth finish.
features.zh: 負離子功能，中和靜電毛躁，順滑亮澤。

features.en: Three heat settings: 160°C, 180°C and 200°C.
4000mAh battery for cordless styling at home or away.
features.zh: 4000mAh 電池，居家或出行皆可無線造型。

features.en: Includes a USB charging cable and portable pouch.
features.zh: 附 USB 充電線及便攜收納袋。

name.zh: 4 合 1 多功能手提筋膜槍

tagline.en: Recovery, in the palm of your hand.

summary.en: A compact massage gun with four intensity levels and four interchangeable heads. A popular wellness gift for active teams and fitness promotions.
summary.zh: 小巧筋膜槍，設四檔力度及四款可替換按摩頭。是運動團隊及健身推廣的熱門健康禮品。

features.en: 1000mAh battery with up to 70 minutes of use.
features.zh: 1000mAh 電池，可操作 70 分鐘。

features.en: Four intensity levels with indicator lights.
features.zh: 4 檔力度調校，配指示燈。

features.en: Four heads included: fork, flat, ball and bullet.
features.zh: 附 4 款按摩頭：叉形、扁形、球形、尖形。

summary.en: A three-port GaN charger delivering up to 65W, compact enough to travel anywhere. A practical tech gift for staff and clients.
summary.zh: 三埠氮化鎵充電器，最高 65W 輸出，小巧便於出行。是送給員工及客戶的實用科技禮品。

features.en: GaN technology improves efficiency while reducing size and heat.
features.zh: 採用氮化鎵（GaN）技術，提升效率，減小體積與發熱。

features.en: One USB-C and two USB-A ports charge three devices at once.
features.zh: 1 個 USB-C 及 2 個 USB-A 埠，可同時為多部裝置充電。

features.en: USB-C delivers up to 65W.
features.zh: USB-C 單埠最高輸出 65W。

features.en: USB-A delivers up to 30W with QC 3.0 support.
features.zh: USB-A 單埠最高 30W，兼容 QC 3.0 快充。

features.en: 100–240V input, suitable for international travel.
features.zh: 支援 100–240V 全球電壓，適合旅行使用。

tagline.zh: 三個接口，一個小巧充電器。

summary.en: A compact three-port GaN charger for everyday phone and accessory charging, with worldwide voltage support. An easy, useful giveaway for corporate events.
summary.zh: 小巧三埠氮化鎵充電器，日常為手機及配件充電，支援全球電壓。是企業活動實用易送的贈品。

features.en: GaN technology for a compact body and lower heat.
features.zh: 氮化鎵技術，體積小巧，發熱更低。

features.en: USB-C1 plus USB-A1 and A2 for three devices at once.
features.zh: USB-C1 及 USB-A1/A2 三個接口，可同時充電。

features.en: USB-C delivers up to 20W.
features.zh: USB-C 最高輸出 20W。

features.en: USB-A delivers up to 18W.
features.zh: USB-A 最高輸出 18W。

features.en: 100–240V input for use around the world.
features.zh: 100–240V 輸入，全球通用。

name.zh: PD 35W 快充旅行轉換插頭

tagline.zh: 無論抵達何方，隨時就緒。

summary.en: A universal travel adaptor with US, EU, UK and AU plugs and 35W PD fast charging. A compact, practical gift for business travellers.
summary.zh: 萬用旅行轉插，支援美規、歐規、英規、澳規插頭，配 PD 35W 快充。小巧實用，適合商務旅客。

features.en: Heat-resistant flame-retardant PC housing with copper busbar contacts.
features.zh: 耐高溫 PC 阻燃外殼，內部採用銅排導電。

features.en: US, EU, UK and AU plug types for international travel.
features.zh: 美規、歐規、英規、澳規插頭，適配多國地區。

features.en: AC socket rated 8A.
features.zh: AC 插座額定電流 8A。

features.en: 35W PD fast charging for phones and tablets.
features.zh: PD 35W 快充，為手機及平板充電。

features.en: Wide 100–250V input for global use.
features.zh: 100–250V 寬電壓輸入，全球通用。

name.zh: 可機洗親膚單人電熱床墊 150 × 80 cm

summary.en: A machine-washable single electric blanket in soft, skin-friendly fabric, with adjustable heat and overheat protection. A comforting winter gift for homes.
summary.zh: 可機洗單人電熱床墊，採用柔軟親膚布料，具多檔溫度調節及過熱保護。是冬季居家的暖心禮品。

features.en: Fast, even heating across the whole surface.
features.zh: 快速均勻加熱，迅速溫暖整個床墊表面。

features.en: Multiple temperature settings for personal comfort.
features.zh: 多檔溫度設定，滿足不同需要。

features.en: Soft, breathable, skin-friendly fabric.
features.zh: 柔軟透氣親膚布料，舒適貼身。

features.en: Automatic overheat protection for safe use.
features.zh: 過熱自動關閉保護，使用更安心。

features.en: Machine washable for easy care.
features.zh: 可機洗，清潔方便。

tagline.en: The glow of a fire, wherever you are.
tagline.zh: 爐火般的暖意，隨處可得。

summary.en: A portable fan heater with a simulated flame display and two heat settings. A cosy seasonal choice for homes and winter promotions.
summary.zh: 便攜暖風機，配仿真火焰效果及兩段溫度。是居家及冬季推廣的溫馨之選。

features.en: Two heat settings.
features.zh: 兩段溫度設定。

features.en: Simulated flame effect for a warm, fireside look.
features.zh: 仿真火焰效果，營造爐火氛圍。

features.en: Portable design moves easily from room to room.
features.zh: 便攜設計，可隨意移動至不同房間。

name.zh: 5kg 雙定量出米密封防潮儲米桶

tagline.en: One bowl or two. Your choice.

summary.en: A 5kg sealed rice dispenser with a two-way dial for one or two portions, on wheels for easy moving. A tidy, hygienic addition to any kitchenware range.
summary.zh: 5kg 密封儲米桶，左右旋鈕可取一碗或兩碗份量，底部附滑輪方便移動。整潔衛生，適合各類廚具系列。

features.en: Turn left for 75g, about one bowl; turn right for 150g, about two.
features.zh: 左轉 90° 出米 75g（約一碗），右轉 90° 出米 150g（約兩碗）。

features.en: Funnel chamber guides every grain out, leaving no old rice behind.
features.zh: 漏斗式出米倉斜坡導流，不留陳米。

features.en: Inset lid with food-grade silicone seal locks out moisture.
features.zh: 嵌入式密封上蓋，內嵌食品級矽膠圈，阻隔濕氣。

features.en: Top compartment holds oxygen absorbers or insect repellent.
features.zh: 頂置防潮盒，可放置脫氧劑或驅蟲片。

features.en: Castors for moving, silicone pads for staying put.
features.zh: 底部滑輪方便移動，矽膠墊防滑穩固。

features.en: Viewing window shows the remaining level at a glance.
features.zh: 透明視窗，隨時掌握餘量。

tagline.en: A seat that goes where you go.

summary.en: A tool-free folding stool in thick PP with a triangular support frame rated to 100kg. A versatile pick for homes, camping and outdoor events.
summary.zh: 免安裝加厚 PP 摺疊凳，三角支撐結構承重達 100kg。適用於居家、露營及戶外活動。

features.en: No assembly needed; opens instantly and folds flat to carry.
features.zh: 免安裝，即開即坐，摺合後輕鬆收納及攜帶。

features.en: Hollow triangular frame supports up to 100kg.
features.zh: 空心三角支撐結構，承重高達 100kg。

features.en: Odour-free, impact-resistant virgin PP, waterproof and easy to clean.
features.zh: 環保 PP 新料，無異味、抗衝擊，防水易清潔。

features.en: Four non-slip feet protect floors and keep it steady.
features.zh: 4 個防滑腳墊，穩固不滑，保護地板。

summary.en: A fabric scent sachet with a beech wood ring, made to hang in wardrobes, cars and luggage. A light, elegant giveaway for events and gift sets.
summary.zh: 配櫸木木環的布袋香囊，可懸掛於衣櫃、車內及行李箱。輕巧雅緻，適合活動贈品及禮盒組合。

features.en: Corn cob filling absorbs and holds fragrance.
features.zh: 玉米芯材質，有效吸收並鎖住香味。

features.en: Beech wood ring for hanging in cabinets, bags or luggage.
features.zh: 櫸木木環設計，可懸掛於櫥櫃、包袋或行李箱。

features.en: About 30 days of fragrance once opened, covering 5–10 m².
features.zh: 拆包後持香約 30 天，擴香面積約 5–10㎡。

features.en: Lasts up to two months in a wardrobe.
features.zh: 置於衣櫃可留香約 2 個月。

features.en: Freshens and helps keep moisture down in wardrobes, cars and bathrooms.
features.zh: 適用於衣櫃、車內及衛生間，除臭防潮。

summary.en: A fabric scent sachet with a beech wood ring, made to hang in wardrobes, cars and luggage. A light, elegant giveaway for events and gift sets.
summary.zh: 配櫸木木環的布袋香囊，可懸掛於衣櫃、車內及行李箱。輕巧雅緻，適合活動贈品及禮盒組合。

features.zh: 玉米芯材質，有效吸收並鎖住香味。

features.en: Beech wood ring for hanging in cabinets, bags or luggage.
features.zh: 櫸木木環設計，可懸掛於櫥櫃、包袋或行李箱。

features.en: About 30 days of fragrance once opened, covering 5–10 m².
features.zh: 拆包後持香約 30 天，擴香面積約 5–10㎡。

features.en: Lasts up to two months in a wardrobe.
features.zh: 置於衣櫃可留香約 2 個月。

features.en: Freshens and helps keep moisture down in wardrobes, cars and bathrooms.
features.zh: 適用於衣櫃、車內及衛生間，除臭防潮。

tagline.en: A soft note of orchid, wherever it hangs.

summary.en: A 25g fabric scent sachet with a beech wood ring, made to hang in wardrobes, cars and luggage. A light, elegant giveaway for events and gift sets.
summary.zh: 25g 布袋香囊，配櫸木木環，可懸掛於衣櫃、車內及行李箱。輕巧雅緻，適合活動贈品及禮盒組合。

features.en: Corn cob filling absorbs and holds fragrance.
features.zh: 玉米芯材質，有效吸收並鎖住香味。

features.en: Beech wood ring for hanging in cabinets, bags or luggage.

tagline.en: Seal in freshness. Save the space.

summary.en: A reusable 30 × 34 cm vacuum storage bag in BPA-free food-grade material, designed for use with a vacuum pump. Keeps fresh food, tea and dried goods compact and protected.
summary.zh: 可重複使用的 30 × 34 cm 真空保鮮袋，採用不含 BPA 的食品級材質，配合真空機使用。保存生熟食品、茶葉及乾貨，節省空間。

features.en: Tough, durable film for repeated use.

features.zh: 雙層拉鍊，取出食品後可再次密封抽氣。

features.en: Suits fresh and cooked food, tea, fruit and dried herbs.
features.zh: 適用於生熟食品、茶葉、瓜果及中藥材。

features.zh: 電子密碼鎖，可設定 3–8 位數密碼。

features.en: Locks for five minutes after three wrong entries.
features.zh: 連續輸錯 3 次自動鎖定，5 分鐘後可重新輸入。

features.en: Opens by code or key.
features.zh: 支援密碼及鑰匙開啟。

features.en: Steel body resists prying and impact.
features.zh: 鋼製箱體，防撬防撞。

features.en: Mounting holes and screws included for fixing to a wall.

features.zh: 304 不鏽鋼，抗腐蝕，不易殘留氣味。

features.zh: 四格獨立分隔，避免食物混味。

features.zh: 飯盒本體可直接放入微波爐加熱。

features.en: Main box can be reheated in the microwave.
